owner_summaries.key_concerns: Control TB.BAL.001 and FX.COV.001 are not operating effectively, leading to potential financial reporting inaccuracies and policy non-compliance.

residual_risks.description: Entity-level trial balance discrepancies (TB.BAL.001) could result in inaccurate financial statements.
residual_risks.mitigation_recommendations: Ensure trial balance reconciliation processes are reviewed and automated checks are implemented.

residual_risks.description: FX rate coverage (FX.COV.001) does not meet policy requirements, increasing regulatory non-compliance risk.
residual_risks.mitigation_recommendations: Update FX rate validation processes and implement periodic reviews to ensure compliance.

residual_risks.description: High flux analysis exceptions (FLUX.ANAL.008) indicate potential anomalies in account balances.
residual_risks.mitigation_recommendations: Investigate and resolve flux analysis exceptions, and enhance monitoring controls.

residual_risks.description: Open HITL case (HITL.CASE.011) indicates a pending manual intervention that could delay process completion.
residual_risks.mitigation_recommendations: Expedite resolution of open HITL cases and implement tracking mechanisms.
